requests.original_text: In addressing these our Annual Letters to you, it is our desire to lead you on in the divine life, that, not contented with a super- ficial acquaintance with religion, you may clearly understand its most discriminating principles.

requests.original_text: But concerning the latter, he directs their whole attention to Christ, and to those who acted under his authority.

requests.original_text: The great principles of the first are of perpetual obli- gation, and know no other variety than that which arises from the varying of relations and conditions : but those of the last may be binding at one period of time, and utterly abolished at another* We can clearly perceive that it were inconsistent with the perfections of God not to have required us to love him and one another, or to have allowed of the contrary.

requests.original_text: Children also must needs be required to obey their parents ; for this is right.
requests.claim: 자녀들은 부모에게 복종해야 한다.

requests.original_text: The obligation of man to love and obey his Creator was coeval with his existence : but it was not till God had planted a garden in Eden, and there put the man whom he had formed, and expressly prohibited the fruit of one of the trees on pain of death, that he came under a positive Jaw.

requests.original_text: The former would approve itself to his conscience as according with the nature of things : the latter as being commanded by his Creator.

requests.original_text: Far be it from us to amuse the churches we represent witb use- less distincctions, or speculations which apply not to the great purposes of practical godliness.

requests.original_text: Your ablest writers have shown from hence the fallacy of all reasonings in favour of infant baptism from the Abrahamic covenant, from circumcision, or from any ground of mere analogy : and not your writers only : for the principle is conceded by a considerable number of our most learned opponents.* In instituted worship, we have only to understand the will of our divine Lawgiver in relation to the subject in question, and to obey it.

requests.original_text: We are not only taught by it to look for ex- press precept or example, in things positive, but not to look for them in things moral.

requests.original_text: But the worship of God, being of moral obligation, extends to the various relations and situations in life.

requests.original_text: As to the keeping of the day holy unto the Lord, this is moral, and not positive, and is there- fore left to be inferred from general principles.

requests.original_text: Positive institutions have all something moral pertain- ing to them, as it respects the holy manner in which they are to be observed.

requests.claim: 교회 정부, 예배, 및 교회 규율에 대한 구체적인 공식화는 신약 성경의 명시적인 권위를 근거로 하여 시도할 수 없는 일이다.

requests.original_text: We doubt not but the apostles acted under divine direction ; but in things of a moral nature that direction consisted, not in pro- viding them with a model, or pattern, in the manner of that given to Moses, but in furnishing them with general principles, and en- duing them with holy wisdom to apply them as occasions re- quired.
requests.claim: 사도들은 신의 지시에 따라 행동했지만, 도덕적인 문제에 대해서는 모세에게 주어진 것과 같은 모범이나 패턴을 제공받지 않고, 일반적인 원칙을 제공받고 그 원칙을 적용할 수 있는 거룩한 지혜를 받았다.

requests.original_text: We learn from the Acts and the Epistles, that the first churches were congregations of faithful men, voluntarily united together for the stated ministration of the word, the administration of Chris- tian ordinances, and the mutually assisting each other in promoting the cause of Christ; that they were governed by bishops and dea- cons; that a bishop was an overseer, not of other ministers, bat of the flock of God ; that the government and discipline of each church was within itself; that the gifts of the different members were so employed as to conduce to the welfare of the body ; and that in cases of disorder, all proper means were used to vindicate the honour of Christ, and reclaim the party.
requests.claim: 초기 교회는 말씀의 선포, 기독교 성례의 집행, 그리고 상호부조를 통한 그리스도님의 사역을 위해 자발적으로 연합한 신자들의 모임으로, 감독과 집사에 의해 관리되었으며, 각 교회는 자체적으로 정부와 규율을 가지고 있었고, 교회의 질서를 회복하기 위해 필요한 모든 수단을 사용하였다.

requests.original_text: That a variety of cases occur in our times, in which we have nothing more than general principles to direct us, is manifest to every person of experience and reflection.
requests.claim: 우리는 일반 원칙만으로 지침을 받는 다양한 경우가 우리 시대에 발생한다는 것이 경험과 반성하는 모든 사람에게 명백하다.

requests.original_text: We know that churches were formed, elders ordained, and prayer and praise conducted with the understanding, or so as to be under, stood by others; but in what particular manner they proceeded m each, we are not told.
requests.claim: 성경에서 교회 설립, 장로 임직, 예배의 진행에 대한 구체적인 방법은 설명되지 않는다.

requests.original_text: We have no account of the formation of a single church, no ordination service, nor any such thing as a for- mula of worship.
requests.claim: 성경에서 교회 설립, 장로 임직, 예배의 진행에 대한 구체적인 방법이나 절차에 대한 설명이 없다.

requests.original_text: We are taught, however, that for the church to grow unto a holy temple in the Lord, it requires to be fitly framed to- gether.
requests.claim: 교회가 거룩한 성전으로 성장하기 위해서는 적절하게 조직되어야 한다.

requests.original_text: The want of fitness in a connexion, therefore, especially if it impede the growth of the spiritual temple, may justify a re-, moval.
requests.claim: 교회가 성령의 성전으로 성장하기 위해 적절하게 조직되어야 하며, 그렇지 못한 경우에는 재배치가 필요할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Or if there be no want of fitness, yet if the material be adapted to occupy a more important station, a removal of it may be very proper.
requests.claim: 교회에서 구성원의 역할을 재조정하는 것은 더 중요한 위치에 적합한 경우에 적절할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Such a principle may be misapplied to ambitious and interested purposes ; but if the increase of the temple be kept in view, it is lawful, and in some cases attended with great and good effects.
requests.claim: 교회 성장과 발전에 대한 원칙이 잘못된 목적에 사용될 수 있지만, 교회의 성장과 발전을 목적으로 한다면 그것은 합법적이며 때때로 좋은 결과를 가져올 수 있다.

requests.original_text: This instance may suffice instead of a hundred, and goes to show that the forms and orders of the New Testament church, much more than of the Old, are founded on the reason of things.
requests.claim: 신약 교회의 형식과 질서는 구약보다 더 많은 경우에 합리적인 근거에 기반한다.

requests.original_text: The principles on which they professed to act, and which they inculcated on others, were these : Let all things be done to edifying. — Let all things be done decently, and in order.
requests.claim: 교회와 개인의 신앙을 건설하기 위한 모든 일은 건전하고 질서정연하게 해야 한다.

requests.original_text: Whatever measures had a tendency to build up the church of God, and individuals, in their most holy faith, these they pursued.
requests.claim: 교회와 개인의 신앙을 건설하는 모든 조치를 추구한다.

requests.original_text: Whatever measures approved them- selves to minds endued with holy wisdom, as fit and lovely, and as tending, like good discipline in an army, to the enlargement of Christ's kingdom, these they followed, and inculcated on the churches.
requests.claim: 교회와 개인의 신앙을 세우는 모든 조치와 그리스도 왕국의 확장을 위한 규율이 좋고 사랑스럽다고 생각되는 조치를 따르는 것이 중요하다.

requests.original_text: And however worldly minds may have abused the principle, by introducing vain customs under the pretence of dc~ efney, it is that which, understood in its simple and original sense* must still be the test of good order and Christian discipline.
requests.claim: 기독교 교회에서 좋은 질서와 기독교 규율의 기준은 그 원래 의미에서 이해할 때 여전히 유효하다.

requests.original_text: The way in which the apostles actually proceeded in the forming and organizing of churches, corresponds with this statement of things.
requests.claim: 사도들이 실제로 교회를 형성하고 조직하는 방식은 이러한 성명과 일치한다.

requests.original_text: When a number of Christians were assembled together in the days of pentecost, they were considered as a Christian church.
requests.claim: 초기 기독교 공동체는 성령강림절 당시 모인 기독교인들로 구성된 교회로 간주되었다.

requests.original_text: But at first they had no deacons, and probably no pas- tors, except the apostles.
requests.claim: 초기 기독교 공동체는 처음에는 집사나 목회자를 제외한 사도들만 가지고 있었을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: And if the reason of things had not re- quired it, they might have continued to have none.
requests.claim: 교회가 새로운 상황에 따라 새로운 직분이나 사역자를 두는 것이 필요할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost, and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
requests.claim: 교회는 새로운 필요에 따라 새로운 봉사자를 임명하여 교회 업무를 효과적으로 수행해야 한다.

requests.original_text: All things are done de- cently and in order; all things are done to edifying.
requests.claim: 모든 것이 정당하게 그리고 질서정연하게 행해지며, 모든 것이 건설적으로 행해진다.

requests.original_text: It is not difficult to perceive the wisdom of God in thus varying the twc dispensations.
requests.claim: 하나님의 지혜는 두 가지 성약을 이렇게 다르게 하심에 있다.

requests.original_text: The Jewish church was an army of sol- diers, who had to go through a variety of forms in learning their discipline : the Christian church is an army going forth to battle.
requests.claim: 유대교 교회와 기독교 교회는 각각 다른 방식으로 하나님의 군대이다.

requests.original_text: The members of the first were taught punctilious obedience, and led with great formality through a variety of religious evolutions ; but those of the last (though they also must keep their ranks, and act in obedience to command whenever given) are not required to be so attentive to the mechanical as to the mental, not so much to the minute observance of forms as to the spirit and design of them.
requests.claim: 기독교 교회는 유대교 교회와 달리 형식적인 규칙보다는 정신과 목적에 더 중점을 둔다

requests.original_text: The order of the one would almost seem to have been appointed for order's sake : but in that of the other the utility of every thing is apparent.
requests.claim: 하나의 순서는 순서를 위한 것처럼 보이지만, 다른 하나는 모든 것이 유용한 목적을 가지고 있다.

requests.original_text: The obedience of the former was that of chil- dren : the latter that of sons arrived at maturer age.
requests.claim: 아들의 순종은 성숙한 나이에 이른 아들의 순종이다.

requests.original_text: As our Saviour abolished the Jewish law of divorce, and re- duced marriage to its original simplicity ; so, having abolished the form and order of the church, as appointed by Moses, he reduced it to what, as to its first principles, it was from the beginning, and to what must have corresponded with the desires of believers iu every age.
requests.claim: 그리스도는 율법의 이혼 규정을 폐지하고 결혼을 원래의 단순함으로 회복시켰듯이, 교회의 형식과 모세가 정한 질서를 폐지하고 교회를 처음부터 존재했던 원리와 모든 시대의 신자들의 소원에 부합하는 것으로 회복시켰다.

requests.original_text: It was natural for the sons of God, in the days of Seth, to assemble together, and to call upon the name of the Lord; and their unnatural fellowship with unbelievers brought on the deluge.
requests.claim: 하나님의 아들들은 자연스럽게 하나님을 부르며 함께 모여야 하며, 믿지 않는 사람들과의 교제는 대홍수를 가져왔다.

requests.original_text: And even under the Jewish dispensation, wicked men, though de-: scended from Abraham, were not considered as Israelites indeed, or true citizens of Zion The friends of God were then the cow- panions of those that feared him.
requests.claim: 유대인 계통에 속한 악한 사람들은 참된 이스라엘 사람이나 시온의 참된 시민으로 간주되지 않았다

requests.original_text: There is scarcely a precept on the sub- ject of church discipline, but what may, in substance, be found in the Proverbs of Solomon.
requests.claim: 교회 규율에 관한 교훈은 솔로몬의 잠언에서 대부분 찾을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Nor does it follow that all forms of worship and church-govern- ment are iudifferent, and left to be accommodated to times, places, and circumstances.
requests.claim: 모든 예배와 교회 정부 형태가 무차별적이고 시간, 장소, 상황에 따라 조정될 수 있는 것은 아님

requests.original_text: The principles, or general outlines of things, are marked out, and we are not at libertv to deviate from them ;
requests.claim: 교회에서의 예배와 교회 정부의 형태는 특정 원칙이나 일반적인 윤곽에 따라 결정되어야 하며, 이 원칙에서 벗어나서는 안 된다.

requests.original_text: It does follow, however, that scripture precedent, important a^ it is, is not binding on Christians in a moral nature, unless the rea^ son of the thing be the same in the case to be proved as in the case adduced.
requests.claim: 성경의 선례는 중요하지만, 그 이유가 동일하지 않은 경우에는 기독교인들에게 도덕적으로 강제할 수 없다.

requests.original_text: But it does not follow that we who have more convenient houses should do so.
requests.claim: 초기 기독교인들이 예배를 위해 적절한 장소를 갖지 못한 것과는 달리, 현재 우리는 더 편리한 집을 가지고 있기 때문에 같은 방식으로 예배를 드릴 필요는 없다.

requests.original_text: The first Christians were exhorted to salute one another with a holy kiss.
requests.claim: 초기 기독교인들은 성스러운 입맞춤으로 서로 인사하도록 권고받았다.

requests.original_text: The reason was, it was the custom in the east for men in general in this manner to express their affection ; and all that the apostle did, was to direct that this common mode of affectionate saluta- tion should be used in a religious way.
requests.claim: 초기 기독교인들은 성스러운 입맞춤으로 서로 인사하는 관습을 지녔으며, 이는 동양에서 일반적으로 애정을 표현하는 방식이었고, 사도는 이 관습을 종교적인 방식으로 사용하도록 지시했다.

requests.original_text: In places where it is a common practice, it may still be used to express the strength of Christian affection : but in a country where the practice is nearly confined to the expression of affection between the sexes, it is certainly much more liable to misconstruction and abuse. — And as it was never a divine institution, but merely a human ctistom applied to a religious use, where this custom has ceased, though the spirit of the precept remains, yet the form of it may lawfully be dispensed with, and Christian affection ex- pressed in the ordinary modes of salutation.
requests.claim: 기독교적인 애정을 표현하는 방법은 지역의 관습에 따라 달라질 수 있으며, 특정한 형식이 아닌 애정의 정신이 중요하다.

requests.original_text: Again : The Corinthian men were forbidden to pray or pro- phesy with theif heads covered.
requests.claim: 코린토 교회에서 남자들은 기도나 예언을 할 때 머리를 덮어서는 안 되었다.

requests.original_text: The reason was, the head being uncovered was then the sign of authority, and its being covered, of subjection.
requests.claim: 당시 코린토에서 머리를 덮은 것은 복종의 표시였고, 머리를 덮지 않은 것은 권위의 표시였다.

requests.original_text: But in our age and country, each is a sign of the contrary.
requests.claim: 현재 우리의 시대와 지역에서는, 권위와 복종의 상징이 역전되어 있다.

requests.original_text: It also follows that in attending to positive institutions, neither express precept nor precedent are necessary in what respects the holy manner of performing them, nor binding in regard of mere accidental circumstances, which do not properly belong to them.
requests.claim: 성도들은 성례를 거행할 때 거룩한 방식으로 행해야 하며, 우연한 상황은 성례의 본질과 관련이 없다.

requests.original_text: It required neither express precept nor precedent, to make it the duty of the Corinthians, when they met to celebrate the Lord's supper, to do it soberly, and in the fear of God, nor to render the contrary a sin.
requests.claim: 코린토 교회가 주의 만찬을 지킬 때 절제와 하나님을 두려워하는 마음으로 행하는 것은 명시적인 계명이나 전례가 필요하지 않으며, 그 반대는 죄이다.

requests.original_text: It is a fact that the Lord's supper was first celebrated with unleavened bread ; for no leaven was found at the time in all the Jewish habitations : but no mention being made of it, either in the institution, or in the repetition of it by the apostle, we conclude it was a mere acci- dental circumstance, no more belonging to the ordinance than its having been in a large upper room.
requests.claim: 주님의 만찬은 처음에 무교병으로 거행되었지만, 이는 계명의 일부가 아니므로 우리에게 구속력이 없다.

requests.original_text: It is a fact too, that our Lord and his disciples sat in a reclining posture at the supper, after the manner of sitting at their ordinary meals : yet none imagine this to be binding upon us.
requests.claim: 주님의 만찬에서 예수님과 제자들이 기울여 앉아 식사한 것은 의식의 필수 요소가 아님을 알 수 있다.

requests.original_text: It is also a fact, with regard to the time that our Saviour first sat down with his disciples on the evening of the Jifth day of the week, the night in which he was betrayed : but though that was a memorable night, and worthy to be noticed as a circumstance tending to show the strength of his love, yet seeing the words of the institution decide not how often it shall be attended to, and no mention is made of its being afterwards a rule, but, on the contrary, of the church at Troas meeting for the purpose on another day, no one imagines it to be a rule of conduct to us.
requests.claim: 주님의 만찬에 대한 시간과 빈도는 성경에서 명시적으로 규정되어 있지 않다.

requests.original_text: Whether there be express preceptor prece- dent for it, or not, is of no consequence : for the distinction of sex is a mere circumstance, in nowise affecting the qualifications required, and therefore not belonging to the institution.
requests.claim: 성별은 성례전의 자격요건에 영향을 미치지 않는 순수한 상황이므로, 성별에 따른 차별은 중요하지 않다.

requests.original_text: It is of just as much account as whether a believer be a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free man ; that is, it is of no account at all. — For there is nei- ther Jew nor Greek, bond nor free, male nor female ; but all are one in Christ Jesus.
requests.claim: 성별은 그리스도 안에서 중요하지 않다

requests.original_text: Express precept or precedent might as well be demanded for the parties being tall or low, black or white, sickly or healthy, as for their being male or female.
requests.claim: 남녀의 차이와 같은 물리적 속성은 교회에서의 역할이나 참여에 영향을 미치지 않는다.

requests.original_text: It follows, lastly, that many disputes, on which Christians have divided and crumbled into parties, might well have been spared,
requests.claim: 많은 기독교인들이 분열되고 파티로 나뉘는 논쟁들은 피할 수 있었을 것이다.

requests.original_text: and that without any disadvantage to the cause of pure religion.
requests.claim: 순수한 종교의 원인에 해가 되지 않는다

requests.original_text: Whatever necessity there may be for withdrawing from those who walk disorderly, we have no warrant to consider those things as the standard of order, and to censure our brethren for deviating from them, which belong not to the laws of Christ, but either to a mere difference of opinion respecting their application, or to some accidental circumstance which may or may not attend them.
requests.claim: 교회 질서의 기준은 그리스도의 법에 따라야 하며, 개인의 의견 차이 또는 우연한 상황에 따라 판단해서는 안 된다.

requests.original_text: Finally, brethren : While you guard against the extremes of certain disciplinarians on the one hand, avoid those of anti-disci- plinararians on the other.
requests.claim: 교회의 규율에 대한 두 극단(규율주의자와 반규율주의자)을 피해야 한다.

requests.original_text: Allow us to repeat what was observed at the beginning, that an unreserved obedience to the revealed will of God, in whatever form it is delivered, is the scriptural test of faith and love.
requests.claim: 하나님의 계시된 뜻에 대한 무조건적인 순종은 성경적인 믿음과 사랑의 시험입니다.

requests.original_text: Prove what that good, perfect, and acceptable will of the Lord is.
requests.claim: 하나님의 계시된 뜻에 대한 무조건적인 순종은 성경적인 믿음과 사랑의 시험입니다.

requests.original_text: Remember that the wisdom which is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
requests.claim: 하늘에서 오는 지혜는 첫째 순수하고, 두번째 평화로우며, 부드럽고, 권유에 쉽게 응하며, 자비와 좋은 열매로 가득 차 있으며, 편견이 없고, 위선이 없다.

requests.original_text: The God of love and peace be with you.
requests.claim: 사랑과 평화의 하나님께서 당신과 함께 하시기를 빕니다.

requests.original_text: In our last public Letter, we addressed you on the work of the Holy Spirit : in this we would direct your attention to the promise of the Spirit as the grand encouragement in promoting the spread of the gospel.
requests.claim: 성령의 약속은 복음의 전파를 촉진하는 큰 격려이다.

requests.original_text: We may be of what is called a sect, but we must not be of a sectarian spirit, seeking only the promotion of a party.
requests.claim: 크리스천은 어떤 종파에 속해있을 수 있지만, 정당의 증진만을 추구하는 세대주의적인 정신을 지녀서는 안된다.

requests.original_text: The true churches of Jesus Christ travail in birth for the salvation of men.
requests.claim: 진정한 예수 그리스도의 교회는 사람들의 구원을 위하여 분만의 고통을 겪는다.

requests.original_text: The influence of the Holy Spirit is by some disowned, by others abused; and even those who are the subjects of it, from various causes, enjoy much less of it than might be expected.
requests.claim: 성령의 영향은 일부 사람들에 의해 거부되거나 남용되며, 심지어 그것을 받는 사람들조차 다양한 이유로 예상보다 훨씬 적게 즐긴다.

requests.original_text: It is not for us to acquiesce in either ; but, while we despair of success from mere human efforts, to trust in Him, who, when sending forth his servants to teach all nations, promised to be with them to the end of the world.
requests.claim: 인간의 노력만으로는 이방인의 마음을 변화시키는 것은 불가능하지만, 하나님의 도우심을 믿고 그분이 약속하신 대로 모든 민족을 가르치기 위해 보내신 종들을 통해 이루어진다.

requests.original_text: There are those, on the other hand, who abuse the doctrine, by converting it into an argument for sloth and avarice.
requests.claim: 일부 사람들은 게으름과 탐욕을 변명하는 논리로 교리를 남용한다.

requests.original_text: Yes, he can ; and probably he will,
requests.claim: 하나님은 원하시면 죄인을 회심시킬 수 있으며, 우리의 노력이나 기여 없이도 그렇게 하실 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Deliverance will arise from other quarters, and they who con- tinue in this spirit will be destroyed !
requests.claim: 구원은 다른 곳에서 오고, 이러한 영으로 남아있는 자들은 멸망할 것이다.

requests.original_text: Even those in whom the Spirit of God is, enjoy much less of it than might be expected; and this is principally for want of the things which were stated in our letter of last year ; namely, set- ting a proper value upon it, seeking it with fervent prayer, placing an entire dependence upon it, and maintaining a deportment suita- ble to it.
requests.claim: 성령의 은사를 받은 사람들조차도 성령의 은사를 충분히 경험하지 못하는 경우가 많으며, 이는 성령의 은사를 올바르게 평가하지 못하고, 성령을 간절히 구하지 않으며, 성령에게 전적으로 의존하지 않으며, 성령에 합당한 행동을 하지 않기 때문이다.

requests.original_text: In proving, therefore, that the promise of the Holy Spirit is the grand encouragement in promoting the spread of the gospel, we have not merely to oppose the adversaries of the doc- trine, but to instruct and impress the minds of its friends.
requests.claim: 성령의 약속은 복음의 확장을 촉진하는 데 큰 격려가 된다.

requests.original_text: First: The success of God's cause under the Old Testament was considered by believers in those days as depending entirely upon God. — God had a cause in the world from the earliest ages, and this it was which interested the hearts of his servants.
requests.claim: 구약 시대에 하나님의 일의 성공은 믿는 이들이 하나님께 완전히 의존한다고 여겼다.

requests.original_text: It was for the setting up of his spiritual kingdom in the world that he blessed the seed of Abraham, and formed them into a people.
requests.claim: 하나님의 영적 왕국을 세우기 위해 아브라함의 자손을 축복하시고 백성이 되게 하셨다.

requests.original_text: This was the work that he carried on from generation to genera- tion among them.
requests.claim: 하나님은 세대에서 세대로 그의 영적 왕국을 세우기 위해 아브라함의 자손을 축복하고 그들을 한 민족으로 형성하였다.

requests.original_text: When, therefore, sentence was passed on the people who came up out of Egypt, that they should die in the wil- derness, Moses, who on that occasion seems to have written the ninetieth Psalm, was deeply concerned, lest, in addition to tempo- ral judgments, the Lord should withdraw from them his Holy Spirit.
requests.claim: 모세는 이스라엘 백성이 광야에서 죽게 될 때에 하나님의 성령이 그들로부터 떠나가지 않기를 간절히 바랐습니다.

requests.original_text: It is worthy of notice that this prayer was answered.
requests.claim: 이 기도는 응답을 받았다.

requests.original_text: Though the first generation fell in the wilderness, yet the labours of Moses and his companions were blessed to the second.
requests.claim: 모세와 그의 동료들의 노력은 첫 세대가 광야에서 떨어졌음에도 불구하고 두 번째 세대에게 축복이 되었다.

requests.original_text: These were the most devoted to God of any generation that Israel ever saw.
requests.claim: 이스라엘이 본 모든 세대 중에서 이 세대가 하나님께 가장 헌신적인 세대였다.

requests.original_text: Israel ivas holiness unto the Lord, and the first fruits of his increase.
requests.claim: 이스라엘은 주님께 거룩함이었고, 그의 증가의 첫 열매였다.

requests.original_text: but though desirous of the wages of unrighteousness, was compelled to forego them, and his curse turned into a blessing.
requests.claim: 하나님은 불의의 대가를 원하는 자에게도 축복을 주실 수 있다.

requests.original_text: We are taught by this case, amidst temporal calamities and judgments, in which our earthly hopes may be in a manner extinguished, to seek to have the loss repaired by spiritual blessings.
requests.claim: 신자들은 세속적 재난과 심판 가운데서도 영적 축복을 통해 손실을 보상받으려고 노력해야 한다.

requests.original_text: When the temple was burnt, and the people reduced to slavery in a foreign land, it must seem as if the cause of God iu the world would go to ruin.
requests.claim: 하나님의 사역이 전 세계에서 실패할 것처럼 보였을 때

requests.original_text: O Lord, revive, or preserve alive thy work in the midst of the years : in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy This prayer also was answered.
requests.claim: 하나님은 자신의 일을 살리고 기억하사 긍휼을 나타내신다.

requests.original_text: The work of God did not suffer, but was pro- moted by the captivity.
requests.claim: 하나님의 작품은 포로로 인해 손상되지 않고 오히려 발전했다.

requests.original_text: The church was purified, and the world, beholding the divine interposition, acknowledged, The Lord hath done great things for them.
requests.claim: 하나님의 교회는 순수해졌고, 세상의 사람들은 하나님의 개입을 보고, 주님께서 그들을 위해 큰 일을 하셨다고 인정했다.

requests.original_text: On inquiry of the angel what these meant, he was answered, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith the Lord of Hosts.
requests.claim: 하나님의 영으로 말미암아 일이 성취됨을 강조한다

requests.original_text: For like as the candlestick is supplied without the hand of man, so God will prosper his cause, not by worldly power or armies, but by his gracious influence and superintending providence.
requests.claim: 하나님의 은혜와 주관의 영향력으로 인해 세상의 권력이나 군대가 아닌 하나님의 주관이 그의 일을 형통하게 하실 것

requests.original_text: Here also a lesson is taught us, not to wait for legal protection, or even tole- ration, before we endeavour to introduce the gospel into a country ;
requests.claim: 복음 전파는 법적 보호나 관용을 기다리지 말고 하나님의 은혜와 섭리의 영향력으로 추진되어야 한다.

requests.original_text: but to engage in the work, trusting in God, not only to succeed our labours, but, while acting on Christian principles, either to give us favour in the eyes of those with whom we have to do, or Strength to endure the contrary.
requests.claim: 하나님의 섭리와 힘을 신뢰하며 기독교 원칙에 따라 행동할 때 성공이나 어려움에 직면하여도 하나님께서 우리를 도와주실 것이라는 믿음

requests.original_text: Further : The success of the gospel in the times of the apos- tles is ascribed to the influence of the Holy Spirit, as its first or primary cause.
requests.claim: 성령님의 영향이 복음의 성공의 첫째 또는 주요한 원인이다.

requests.original_text: That the truth of the doctrine, and even the manner in which it was delivered, contributed as second causes to its success, is allowed.
requests.claim: 복음의 성공은 성령의 영향과 함께 그 진리와 전달 방식이 기여한 것으로 보인다.

requests.original_text: But if we look to either of these as the first cause, we shall be unable to account for the little success of our Lord's preaching when com- pared with that of his apostles.
requests.claim: 주님의 설교와 사도들의 설교의 성공을 비교할 때, 주님의 설교가 상대적으로 적은 성공을 거두었던 이유는 주님을 첫째 원인으로 보는 것에 있다.

requests.original_text: He spake as never man spake ; yet compared with them, he laboured in vain, and spent his strength for nought and in vain.
requests.claim: 주님의 설교는 다른 사도들의 설교에 비해 상대적으로 성공적이지 못했다

requests.original_text: It is the Holy Spirit to which the differ- ence is ascribed.
requests.claim: 성령님께서는 그 차이를 설명해 주십니다.

requests.original_text: In promising to be with his disciples to the end of the world, he could refer to no other than his spiritual presence : to this, there- fore, he taught them to look for encouragement.
requests.claim: 예수님의 세계 끝까지의 함께 하심은 영적인 현현을 의미하며, 이를 통해 제자들은 격려를 받도록 가르침을 받았다.

requests.original_text: To this cause the success of the apostles is uniformly ascribed.
requests.claim: 사도들의 성공은 영적 존재의 결과이다

requests.original_text: The hand oj the Lord was with them, and a great number believed, and turned to the Lord — God always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place. — The Lord opened the heart op Lydia, and she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul. — The weapons of our warfare are mighty through God, to the pulling down of strong holds.
requests.claim: 하나님의 손이 함께 하시므로 많은 사람이 믿어 주님께 돌아오고, 하나님은 우리를 그리스도 안에서 항상 승리하게 하시며, 모든 곳에서 우리를 통해 그의 지식의 향기를 나타내신다.

requests.original_text: The great success which prophecy gives us to expect in the latter days is ascribed to the same cause.
requests.claim: 마지막 날들의 큰 성공은 성령이 높은 곳에서 우리에게 부어지는 것과 관련이 있다.

requests.original_text: Then the wilderness would be a fruitful field, and that which had been hitherto considered as a fruitful field would be counted a forest.
requests.claim: 성령이 우리 위에 부어질 때 광야는 결실 많은 들이 되고, 이전에 결실 많은 들로 여겨졌던 곳은 숲으로 여겨질 것이다.

requests.original_text: But the fact was, that in Corinth, a sink of debauchery, God had much people ; whereas in Athens, the seat of polite literature, there were*only a few indi- viduals who embraced the truth.
requests.claim: 하나님의 백성은 도덕적으로 부패한 도시인 고린도에 많았지만, 문명화된 도시인 아테네에는 거의 없었다.

requests.original_text: Nor was this the greatest display of the freeness of the Spirit : Jerusalem, which had not only withstood the preaching and miracles of the Lord, but had actually put him to death — Jerusalem bows at the pouring out of his Spirit ; and not merely the common people, but a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
requests.claim: 성령의 자유함은 예루살렘에서 나타났는데, 예루살렘은 주님의 설교와 기적을 거부하고 그를 죽인 곳이었지만, 성령의 부어주심으로 인해 많은 사제들이 믿음에 복종했다.

requests.original_text: To the above may be added, the experience of those whose min- istry has been most blessed to the turning of sinners to God. — ■ Men of light and speculative minds, whose preaching produces scarcely any fruit, will go about to account for the renewal of the mind by the established laws of nature : but they who see most of this change among their hearers, see most of God in it, and have been always ready to subscribe to the truth of our Lord's words to Peter, Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Fa- ther who is in heaven.
requests.claim: 성도들의 회심은 하나님의 섭리와 은혜의 결과이며, 인간의 지식이나 노력만으로는 설명할 수 없다.

requests.original_text: From this brief statement of the evidence of the doctrine, we shall only add a few remarks to enforce the prayer of faith in your endeavours to propagate the gospel both at home and abroad. — This is the natural consequence of the doctrine, ^f all our help be in God, to him it becomes us to look for success.
requests.claim: 하나님의 도움을 믿고 기도하는 것이 복음 전파의 성공을 위한 자연스러운 결과이다.

requests.original_text: It was from a prayer-meeting held in an upper room, that the first Christians descended, and commenced that notable attack on Satan's kingdom in which three thousand fell before them.
requests.claim: 첫 번째 기독교인들은 기도 모임에서 시작하여 사탄의 왕국에 대하여 공격을 시작하였다.

requests.original_text: When Peter was im- prisoned, prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
requests.claim: 교회는 사도 베드로가 투옥되었을 때 끊임없이 하나님께 기도했다.

requests.original_text: It was in prayer that the late undertakings for spreading the gospel among the heathen originated.
requests.claim: 복음 전파 운동은 기도에서 시작되었다.

requests.original_text: We have seen success enough attend them to encourage us to go forward : and probably if we had been more sensible of ur dependence on the Holy Spirit, and more impor- tunate in our prayers, we should have seen much more.
requests.claim: 성도들의 기도와 성령에 대한 의존도가 높을수록 복음 전파의 성공이 더 많이 따라온다.

requests.original_text: The prayer of faith falls not to the ground.
requests.claim: 믿음의 기도는 헛되지 않다.

requests.original_text: Consider, brethren, the dispensation under which we live. — We are under the kingdom of the Messiah, fitly called the minis* tration of the Spirit, because the richest effusions of the Holy Spirit are reserved for his reign, and great accessions to the church from among the Gentiles ordained to grace his triumphs.
requests.claim: 우리는 메시야의 왕국, 즉 성령의 사역 아래 살고 있으며, 이 시대에는 성령의 풍성한 은사가 풍성하게 부어지고 밖으로, 이방인들로부터 교회가 성장하여 메시야의 승리를 영화롭게 한다.

requests.original_text: It was fit that the death of Christ should be followed by the- out-pouring of the Spirit, that it might appear to be what it was, its proper effect ; and that which was seen in the days of Pentecost was but an earnest of what is yet to come.
requests.claim: 그리스도의 죽음 이후에 성령의 부어짐이 따랐으며, 이는 그리스도의 죽음의 적절한 결과였고, 오순절의 날에 나타난 것은 아직 오지 않은 것의 예표였다.

requests.original_text: To pray under such a dispen- sation is coming to God in a good time.
requests.claim: 하나님의 은혜의 시기에 하나님께 기도하는 것은 적절한 때에 기도하는 것이다.

requests.original_text: In asking for the success of the gospel, we ask that of the Father of heaven and earth in which his soul delighteth, and to which he has pledged his every perfection ; namely, to glorify his Son.
requests.claim: 복음의 성공을 구하는 것은 하나님의 아들을 영광시키는 것에 대한 아버지의 약속을 구하는 것

requests.original_text: Finally : Compare the current language of prophecy with the state of things in the world, and in the church. — In whatever obscurity the minutiae of future events may be involved, the events themselves are plainly revealed.
requests.claim: 예언의 언어와 세계 및 교회의 현재 상태를 비교하면 미래 사건의 세부 사항이 어둡게 둘러싸여 있을지라도 사건 자체는 분명하게 계시된다.

requests.original_text: We have seen the four monarchies, or preponderating powers, described by Daniel, as successively ruling the world ; namely, the Babylonian, the Per- sian, the Macedonian, and the Roman.
requests.claim: 다니엘서에 기록된 세계를 지배한 네 개의 제국, 즉 바빌론, 페르시아, 마케도니아, 로마 제국이 순차적으로 세계를 지배했다.

requests.original_text: We have seen the last subdivided into ten kingdoms, and the little papal horn growing up among them.
requests.claim: 다니엘서에 기록된 세계를 지배한 네 개의 제국은 바빌론, 페르시아, 마케도니아, 로마이며, 마지막 제국은 열 개의 왕국으로 나뉘고 그 중에서 작은 교황의 뿔이 자라난다.

requests.original_text: We have seen the saints of the Most High worn out for more than a thousand years by its persecutions.
requests.claim: 성도들은 가장 높은 분의 성도들로서 1000년 이상 동안 박해를 받았다.

requests.original_text: We have seen his rise, his reign, and, in a considerable degree, his down- fall.
requests.claim: 하나님의 성도들은 오랜 세월 동안 많은 핍박을 받았으며, 적그리스도는 권력을 잡고 권력을 잃는 과정을 보았다.

requests.original_text: The judgment is set, and they have begun to takeaway his dominion ; and will go on to consume and to destroy it unto the end And when this is accomplished, the kingdom, and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, will be given to th' people of the saints of the Most High.
requests.claim: 하나님의 심판이 시작되어 악의 세력을 파괴하고, 성도들에게는 하나님의 나라와 권세가 주어질 것

requests.original_text: It is not improbable that the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, have already commenced ; which voice, while it ushers in the vials or seven last plagues upon the antichristian powers, is to the church a signal of prosperity : for the seventh angel hav- ing sounded, voices are heard in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord and of his Christ :
requests.claim: 일곱 번째 천사의 소리의 날들이 이미 시작되었을 수 있으며, 이는 반기독교 세력에 대한 일곱 마지막 재앙의 시작과 동시에 교회에게는 번영의 신호가 된다.

requests.original_text: and he shall reign for ever and ever.
requests.claim: 그는 영원토록 다스릴 것이다.

requests.original_text: The glorious things spoken of the church are not all confined to the days of the millennium : many of them will go before it, in like manner as the victorious days of David went before the rest, or pacific reign of Solomon, and prepared its way.
requests.claim: 교회에 대한 영광스러운 말들은 모두 천년왕국 의 날에 국한되지 않는다.

requests.original_text: Previous to the fall of Babylon, an angel is seen flying in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gos- pel to preach to them that dwell on the earth ; and before that terrible conflict in which the beast and the false prophet are taken, the Son of God is described as riding forih on a white horse, and the armies of heaven as following him.
requests.claim: 하늘 가운데서 날아가며 영원한 복음을 전하는 천사가 나타나고, 백마 타고 나타나는 하나님의 아들이 그 뒤를 따른다.

requests.original_text: The final ruin of the antichristian cause will be brought upon itself by its opposition to the progress of the gospel.
requests.claim: 안티그리스도적인 사상의 최종적인 패배는 복음의 진행에 대한 그들의 반대에 의해 자아내어진다.

requests.original_text: The sum is, that the time for the promulgation of the gospel is come ; and if attended to in a full dependence on the promise of the Spirit, it will, no doubt, be successful. — The rough places in its way are smoothing, that all flesh may see the salvation of God.
requests.claim: 복음의 선포는 성공할 것이며, 모든 사람이 하나님의 구원을 볼 수 있도록 방해되는 장애물들이 제거되고 있다.

requests.original_text: It was so at the coming of our Lord, and probably will be so in much that is before us.
requests.claim: 주님의 오심과 앞으로 있을 사건들에서 가장 중요한 일들은 믿지 않는 세상의 관찰을 피할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: But if we keep our eye on the kingdom of God, whatever become of the kingdoms of this world, we shall reap advantage from every thing that passes before us.
requests.claim: 하나님의 나라를 주목하면 이 세상의 왕국이 어떠하든지 모든 일에서 이익을 얻을 수 있다.

requests.original_text: God in our limes is shaking the heavens and the earth : but there are things which cannot be sha- ken.
requests.claim: 하나님은 하늘과 땅을 흔들고 계시지만, 흔들리지 않는 것들이 있습니다.

requests.original_text: Wherefore, we receiving a kingdom ichich cannot be moved, let us have grace whereby we may serve God acceptably, with rev- erence and godly fear.
requests.claim: 신자들은 흔들리지 않는 왕국을 받았으므로, 하나님을 두려움과 신뢰로 받들며 기쁘게 섬기기 위해 은혜를 받아야 한다.

requests.original_text: Mercy is a distinguishing character of the religion of the Bible, especially to the fatherless and the widow.
requests.claim: 성경의 종교는 특히 고아와 과부에게 자비를 나타낸다.

requests.original_text: The great God claims to be their protector and avenger.
requests.claim: 하나님은 고아와 과부의 보호자와 보복자라고 주장한다.

requests.original_text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widow, is God in his holy habitation.
requests.claim: 하나님은 고아와 과부의 아버지이자 판관이다.

requests.original_text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
requests.claim: 하나님은 고아와 과부를 보호하시며, 그들을 학대하는 자는 하나님의 진노를 받을 것이다.

requests.original_text: Mercy to the fatherless and the widow is introduced as a test of true reli- gion.
requests.claim: 진정한 종교는 고아와 과부에게 자비를 베푸는 것을 포함한다

requests.original_text: Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep ourselves unspotted from the world.
requests.claim: 진정한 종교는 고아와 과부를 방문하여 그들의 고난을 도와주고, 동시에 세상을 향한 우리의 삶을 깨끗이 유지하는 것이라고 할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: The widows and fatherless children of ministers have peculiar claims on the benevolence of the churches.
requests.claim: 목사의 과부와 고아들은 교회의 선행에 특별한 권리를 가지고 있다.

requests.original_text: The ministerial pro- fession, like that of arms, requires the subjects of it, if possible, not to entangle themselves with the affairs of this life, that they may please him who has chosen them to be soldiers.
requests.claim: 목사 직분은 목회자들이 가능하다면 이 세상의 일에 얽매이지 않도록 요구하여, 그들을 선택한 분을 기쁘게 할 수 있도록 한다.

requests.original_text: On this ground, a large proportion of ministers, living entirely on the contributions of their hearers, have no opportunity of providing for their fami.* lies after their decease.
requests.claim: 목사들은 제한된 재정 자원을 가지고 있기 때문에 가족을 위해 미래를 준비하는 기회가 없다.

requests.original_text: You, brethren, by the blessing of God on your diligent attention to business, are generally enabled to meet this difficulty.
requests.claim: 신자들은 하나님의 축복과 사업에 대한 열심으로 인해 어려움을 극복할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: Yet the post occupied by your ministers is honourable and im- portant.
requests.claim: 목사의 직분은 존귀하고 중요하다.

requests.original_text: Regardless of the sneers of the irreligious, they feel it to be so.
requests.claim: 목사들의 직분은 비종교인들의 조롱에도 불구하고 존귀하고 중요하다고 느끼고 있다.

requests.original_text: To be chosen and approved by a Christian congrega- tion, next to the choice and approbation of Christ, is their highest ambition.
requests.claim: 그리스도 다음으로 기독교 회중의 선택과 승인을 받는 것이 그들의 최고의 열망이다.

requests.original_text: Our churches, when in want of ministers, are solicitous to obtain men of talent.
requests.claim: 교회는 목회자 부족 시에 재능 있는 사람들을 얻으려고 노력한다.

requests.original_text: There may be an excess in this desire, especially where personal godliness is overlooked ; and it is certain that great talents are far from being common.
requests.claim: 교회는 재능 있는 목회자를 얻고자 할 때 개인의 신성은 간과할 수 있다.

requests.original_text: But view Christian ministers as a body, and we may appeal to you whether they be not possessed of talents, which, if employed in business, would, with the blessing of God ordinarily bestowed on honest industry,
requests.claim: 기독교 목사들은 일반적으로 사업에 활용될 경우 하나님의 축복이 있는 정직한 산업에 종사하는 경우에 일반적으로 성공할 수 있는 재능을 소유하고 있다.

requests.original_text: The case of superannuated ministers, or ministers who by affliction are permanently laid aside from their work, has a serious influence on the well-being of the churches.
requests.claim: 교회에서 영원히 사역을 못하게 된 목사들의 경우가 교회 공동체의 복지에 심각한 영향을 미친다.
